 Special Leave Petition (Criminal) Diary No(s). 22031/2018

 Versus
 The State Of West Bengal & Ors. Respo
 (Ia No.91390/2018-EXEMPTION From Filing O.T. and Ia No.91391/2018-
 Exemption From Surrendering)
 Date : 16-07-2018 This petition was called on for hearing today.

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mohan M. Shantanagoudar
 [In Chamber]
 For Petitioner(s)

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
Petitioner no. 2 is convicted for the offences punishable under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for three months.
Petitioner no. 2 is exempted from surrendering till the matter comes up before the Court.

However,
he shall have to appear before the Court whenever required.
The matter be placed before the Court within four weeks.
